method.pool_source: SSB KLASS centrality correspondence 2024 (357 municipalities, valid 2024-01-01)
method.scan: rg --json -w -F -f pattern-file over project; excludes .git, .venv, __pycache__, candidate-runtime dirs, binaries, sealed blobs
method.patterns: municipality primary name (SSB bilingual split on ' - ') + ASCII fold + municipality number, word-bounded fixed strings, case-insensitive
method.number_collision_note: 4-digit patterns collide with unrelated numeric fields (latency_ms, floats, byte sizes, pre-2020 municipality numbers); every numeric hit in the selection window was individually verified

classification_rules.PREVIOUSLY_RESEARCHED: in structured prior-research artifacts (sample V1, generalization V1, access V1, routing gap/deep-a/target-sample, sample split, burned runtime)
classification_rules.INCIDENTAL_MENTION_ONLY: hits exist but are metadata lists, national enumerations, benchmark URL spillover, numeric false positives, or old-number collisions; no local service research
classification_rules.HITS_REVIEW_UNREVIEWED: hits exist but muni falls beyond the ordinal selection window; not individually reviewed

exclusion_sources: composite members: Valle, Folldal, Alvdal, Rendalen, Tolga, Indre Fosen, Afjord, Sande
